text.tspan: Corrected: central monitoring with SigNoz for many AWS accounts
Workload account A · dev · EKS cluster
Workload account B · staging · EKS cluster
Workload account C · prod · EKS cluster
Every cluster's collector adds labels: k8s.cluster.name, deployment.environment, cloud.account.id → one SigNoz, filter by source.
Only collectors cross accounts, in one direction, through PrivateLink (overlapping CIDRs don't matter). Apps never send across accounts.
Simpler option: SigNoz Cloud. Each collector exports straight to SigNoz's endpoint with an ingestion key, and there's nothing central to run.
